map.：原 180 s、120 BPM，想练成 220 s 慢速 → 目标 BPM =: : original 180 s at 120 BPM, wanting to practise it at 220 s slowly -> target BPM = 120 x (180/220) ≈ 98.2 BPM (about 18% slower).
map.：原曲 4 分钟（240 s）、原 BPM 120，想提到 140 → 新时长: : original track 4 minutes (240 s) at 120 BPM, wanting 140 -> new duration = 240 x (120/140) ≈ 205.7 s; speed-up = (140/120 - 1) x 100% ≈ 16.7%.
